mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (level) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate for positive 20d returns is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months signals labor market strength, boosting corporate hiring and profits to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise (positive change) in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate increase > 0.1pp in one month signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as markets price in reduced liquidity.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO (level) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate for positive 20d returns is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150k) signals wage inflation pressures, prompting central bank tightening and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 150.0.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% annualized (derived from GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for GDPC1 growth (annualized) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate for positive 60d returns is below 55%.
